changes.comment: Add `agent edit --heartbeat`, `--heartbeat-clear`, `--heartbeat-rules`, `--heartbeat-rules-file`, `--heartbeat-pause`, `--heartbeat-resume` flags and a heartbeat block in `agent show` (#1438).
Add `Schedule heartbeat = 8` derived field to the `Agent` message, `SetAgentHeartbeatRequest`, and `SetAgentHeartbeat` RPC on `GrackleOrchestration` (#1438).
Add `agent.heartbeat.updated` and `agent.heartbeat.cleared` event types to the domain event bus (#1438).
Add `agent.heartbeat.updated` and `agent.heartbeat.cleared` event types to the public `GrackleEventType` union (#1438).

Cron-phase branches on `schedule.task_id`: presence triggers the new heartbeat path (reanimate the target task's latest terminal session and pipe `description` as stdin, with fresh-spawn fallback via `rawPrompt`); absence preserves today's fresh-task-spawn behavior (#1438).
Add `setAgentHeartbeat` RPC handler; `getAgent` / `listAgents` populate the derived `Agent.heartbeat` field by joining `schedules` on the agent's root task (#1438).
